name: Electrify Tech Camp
org: University of Michigan, Electrical and Computer Engineering
what_you_do: A summer day camp taught by U-M engineering faculty. Topics include solar cells and chips, quantum physics, lasers, electric vehicles and AI. No experience needed.
who_can_apply: Current high school freshmen, sophomores and juniors (rising sophomores, juniors or seniors in summer 2027).
pay_detail: $900 per camp. You pay only after you are accepted. Some full and partial scholarships are available.
duration: Not stated on the pages read. It is a day camp with no housing.
deadline_text: The 2027 application date is not posted. Fill out the Electrify 2027 interest form to be told when it opens.
how_to_apply: Apply online and rank the camps you want. If accepted, pay the fee and send an information packet to keep your spot. The scholarship form comes after you are accepted.
notes: Spots are limited and you may not get your first choice. If you cancel, you get $850 back only if your spot is filled. The department also offers a virtual coding program, The Joy of Coding.
